name: 84128 · W Valley City, UT
findings: ZIP 84128 (W Valley City) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84128 (W Valley City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
73% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
